title: Regulatory Compliance Officer
summary: A regulatory compliance officer makes sure a regulated company, such as a bank, NBFC (non-bank lender), broker or insurer, follows the rules set by RBI, SEBI or IRDAI. They sit in the compliance function, track new circulars, test processes, file regulatory returns and train staff on what the rules require.
dailyDuties: Track new RBI, SEBI or IRDAI circulars and circulate impact notes
Update the compliance checklist and compliance calendar
Run compliance testing of products and processes and report findings
Prepare and file monthly and quarterly regulatory returns
Coordinate regulator inspections and close their observations
Run compliance awareness sessions for employees
